info.title: Credential Template — achievement content (mirrors DCC Credential Co-writer)

CredentialTemplate.description: The achievement content produced by the credential_template phase (ADR-0017 phase 1), mirroring the output of the DCC Credential Co-writer this phase is modeled after (field-mapping design §5, FR-FM-5a). It is achievement content only — the issuer_payload / wallet_payload phases assemble the surrounding VC envelope (issuer, recipient, @context, types) around it. Captured by exercising the live Co-writer with representative Mock LMS sample input; two runs produced a stable id/type/name/description/criteria.narrative shape.

credentialSubject.description: Wraps the achievement, matching the Co-writer's output envelope.

id.description: Achievement id. The Co-writer emits a placeholder URI; the issuer_payload phase re-derives the canonical urn from the achievement name, so this is not authoritative here.

description.description: Achievement description — narrative text composed from the learning context (synthesis-backed when synthesis is allowed).
examples: Recognizes the ability to apply core principles of accounting to journalize and post transactions.

criteria.description: How the achievement is earned. The Co-writer produces a single narrative.

narrative.description: Narrative describing the criteria for earning the achievement (synthesis-backed when synthesis is allowed).
examples: Journalize the listed transactions, post them to T-accounts, and show the accounting equation stays in balance.
